[SHUTDOWN]               A: 1   B: 0   C: 0   D: 0   Payload: 
// show current and previous behavior
CHECK VALUE Design Build::value == 1
   CREATE VARIABLE behavior_history::set::behavior
   CREATE VARIABLE current_behavior::user::behavior
   IF/ELSE (CHECK REFERENCE current_behavior::user::behavior is reference to behavior::user::behavior)
      PRINT "<<<<<<<<<<<<<<  Behavior switched to  <<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<" on behavior::user::behavior
      SET REFERENCE current_behavior::user::behavior to behavior::user::behavior
      CHANGE MEMBERSHIP behavior_history::set::behavior.include(current_behavior::user::behavior)
      CHECK VALUE behavior_history::set::behavior > 10
         CHANGE MEMBERSHIP behavior_history::set::behavior.remove(behavior_history::set::behavior@1)
   CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x05] == 1
      FOR EACH in behavior_history::set::behavior, node point 0
         PRINT "" on ~each
// GET FRED'S APPROVAL ON THIS!
CHECK VALUE TRC_Insert_Controller::sprite.field[0x07] == 1
   IF/ELSE (CHECK REFERENCE behavior::user::behavior is reference to Save Game: Waiting for Save Request::behavior)
      IF/ELSE (CHECK REFERENCE behavior::user::behavior is reference to Save Game: Saving::behavior)
         IF/ELSE (CHECK REFERENCE behavior::user::behavior is reference to Save Game: Wait for minimum time to elapse.::behavior)
            // If the 'Insert Controller' message is up, and we aren't in one of the three above behaviors, stop.
PRINT "" on behavior::user::behavior
PRINT "" on card_changed?::user::value
PRINT "" on state_display_message::user::value
PRINT "" on MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value


[BEHAVIOR: Save Game: Waiting for Save Request::behavior] A: 1   B: 88  C: 0   D: 0   Payload: 
   CHECK VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value == 1
      PRINT "..." on self
      PRINT " <========================== A save request has been made!" on self
      IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value == 1)
            PRINT " <<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<  autosave OFF." on self
            SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 0
         PRINT " <------------------------------------- autosave ON..." on self
         SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Pre-Save Verification Process::behavior
         SET VALUE state_verify_card::user::value to 0
         SET VALUE confirm_cancel_save::user::value to 0


[BEHAVIOR: Save Game: Pre-Save Verification Process::behavior] A: 1   B: 72  C: 2   D: 0   Payload: 
   CHECK VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value == 1
      PRINT "In Error Master the player has chosen to continue without saving, so bail out." on self
      SET BEHAVIOR Restore before going back to Waiting for Save Request::behavior
   // Disable the error master so that we can handle the error ourself.
   CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 00
   // Start the Verify Process
   CHECK VALUE state_verify_card::user::value == 0
      PRINT " <============= I am about to trigger a verify..." on behavior::user::behavior
      INCREMENT VALUE state_verify_card::user::value
      // 
      SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
      SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] to 1
// Monitor the verify process
CHECK VALUE state_verify_card::user::value == 1
   SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
   // Monitor the verifying status.  When <> 1,  check status to see result of verify.
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 1)
      IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 0)
            PRINT " <------------------------- Verify SUCCEEDED. There IS a madagascar save file..." on self
            IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE card_changed?::user::value == 1)
                  PRINT " <<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<  card_changed? = 1 -- go to <CARD CHANGED> choice screen." on self
                  SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Card Changed, Select Save Game::behavior
                  SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
                  // If not already paused, then pause.
                  CHECK VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value == 0
                     CUT-SCENE COMMAND: 3 (pause!?)
                     CONTROL Controller Monitor::actor, extra: 01
                     CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 01
                     CONTROL button_prompter::actor, extra: 01
                     SET VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value to 1
                  // Hide sprites
                  CHECK VALUE self.field[0x01] == (self.field[0x01])
                     // Preserve, then hide onscreen, pre-error sprites.
                     CHANGE MEMBERSHIP error_restore_sprites::set::sprite.remove(error_restore_sprites::set::sprite)
                     FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0
                        CHECK VALUE ~each.field[0x07] == 1
                           CHANGE MEMBERSHIP error_restore_sprites::set::sprite.include(~each)
                           SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 0
                     // 
                     // Preserve, then hide onscreen, pre-error button prompt sprites.
                     CHANGE MEMBERSHIP restore_button_prompts_after_message::set::sprite.add(button_prompts::set::sprite)
                     CHANGE MEMBERSHIP button_prompts::set::sprite.remove(button_prompts::set::sprite)
               PRINT " <------------------------------------- card_changed? = 0.  go to <SAVING> process." on self
               SET VALUE state_verify_card::user::value to 10
PRINT " <------------------------- Verify FAILED.  There NOT a good madagascar save file. Go to <CONFIRM CREATE FILE> choice screen." on self
SET BEHAVIOR Title: Refresh (Verify) card before going to New/Load game menus::behavior
SET VALUE new_or_load?::user::value to 0
SET VALUE state_verify_card::user::value to 0
// 
SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
// 
// Hide sprites
CHECK VALUE self.field[0x01] == (self.field[0x01])
   // Preserve, then hide onscreen, pre-error sprites.
   CHANGE MEMBERSHIP error_restore_sprites::set::sprite.remove(error_restore_sprites::set::sprite)
   FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0
      CHECK VALUE ~each.field[0x07] == 1
         CHANGE MEMBERSHIP error_restore_sprites::set::sprite.include(~each)
         SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 0
   // 
   // Preserve, then hide onscreen, pre-error button prompt sprites.
   CHANGE MEMBERSHIP restore_button_prompts_after_message::set::sprite.add(button_prompts::set::sprite)
   CHANGE MEMBERSHIP button_prompts::set::sprite.remove(button_prompts::set::sprite)
// 
// Go ahead with Save
CHECK VALUE state_verify_card::user::value == 10
   SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Saving::behavior
   SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 0
   SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 00


[BEHAVIOR: Save Game: Saving::behavior] A: 1   B: 128 C: 2   D: 0   Payload: 
   // (EXPER) Suspend Error Master so that we can handle errors outself.
   CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 00
   // 
   // 
   CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 0
      INCREMENT VALUE state_display_message::user::value
      // 
      // Let everyone know that we are saving the game.
      SET VALUE IO_Operation_Type::user::value to 0
      // 
      // Calculate the %Complete
      CHECK VALUE self.field[0x01] == (self.field[0x01])
         // Are we playing the furthest unlocked level?
         CHECK VALUE Current Level::value == (furthest_level_unlocked::user::value)
            // If so, set the global furthest_checkpoint_index to the current_checkpoint_index
            SET VALUE furthest_checkpoint_index::user::value to (Current_Checkpoint_Index::user::value)
         // Calculate the % complete
         SET VALUE %_complete_value::user::value to (furthest_level_unlocked::user::value * 2048)
         SET VALUE %_complete_value::user::value to (%_complete_value::user::value + total_money_collected::user::value)
         SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x0b] to (%_complete_value::user::value)
      // 
      // Unhide our spinning saving icon.
      SET VALUE MEM_saving_icon::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
      // 
      SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x04] to 1
      SET VALUE MEM_saving_icon::sprite.field[0x04] to 0
      SET VALUE MEM_saving_icon::sprite.sub[0x03] to 0
      // Start the feedback timer going.  There is a TRC minimum.
      SET VALUE timer_minimum_message_display::user::value to (Script Time::value + MINIMUM_TIME_MESSAGE_DISPLAY::user::value)
// 
// Monitor the saving process
CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 1
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x04] == 1)
         // The saving process is on going, so do nothing.
      // The saving process is over, whether is succeeded or failed.
      SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Waiting for Save Request::behavior
      // The error master actor informs us about the success or failure through the global variable IO_Error
      IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE IO_Error::user::value == 0)
            // Did we finish saving before MemCard Status was resolved by Error Master?
            IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 0)
                  SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Wait for minimum time to elapse.::behavior
                  PRINT "The saving process completed successfully." on MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03]
                  SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 0
               // Memcard status is not resolved yet, so hang out in this behavior a while longer.
               PRINT "Memcard status is not resolved yet, so hang out in this behavior a while longer." on MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03]
               SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Saving::behavior
         FIND VARIABLE disconnect_message_up?::user::value in Controller Monitor::actor
            CHECK VALUE ~found_variable == 1
               SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Saving::behavior
         SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
         SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x04] to 0
         // Note that we are NOT clearing MEMCARD Auto-Save Kickoff.  
         // Therefore, we will repeat the save request, unless the MemCard Error Master actor
         // asynchronously set 'prompted_to_insert_memcard' = 1
         // 
         // Reset the message display timer.
         SET VALUE timer_minimum_message_display::user::value to (Script Time::value + MINIMUM_TIME_MESSAGE_DISPLAY::user::value)
IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x04] == 1)
      // The saving process is on going, so do nothing.
   SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 0
   SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   // 
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x04] == 0)
         PRINT "The saving process completed successfully." on MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03]
         SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Wait for minimum time to elapse.::behavior
      PRINT " <====================== SAVE GAME FAILED! ========================>" on MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03]
      SET BEHAVIOR New Game: Display 'Save Failed' Message::behavior
      SET VALUE MEM_saving_icon::sprite.field[0x07] to 0
      // Pause the Game
      CHECK VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value == 0
         CUT-SCENE COMMAND: 3 (pause!?)
         CONTROL Controller Monitor::actor, extra: 01
         CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 01
         CONTROL button_prompter::actor, extra: 01
         SET VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value to 1


[BEHAVIOR: Save Game: Wait for 'Insert Controller' message to go away::behavior] A: 1   B: 80  C: 0   D: 0   Payload: 
   FIND VARIABLE disconnect_message_up?::user::value in Controller Monitor::actor
      CHECK VALUE ~found_variable == 0
         PRINT "DISCONNECT MESSAGE IS DOWN -- post-insert retry to commence!" on self
         SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Waiting for Save Request::behavior
         SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
         SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x04] to 0
         // Note that we are NOT clearing MEMCARD Auto-Save Kickoff.  
         // Therefore, we will repeat the save request, unless the MemCard Error Master actor
         // asynchronously set 'prompted_to_insert_memcard' = 1
   PRINT "Save master is waiting for the controller to be reinserted." on self


[BEHAVIOR: Save Game: Wait for minimum time to elapse.::behavior] A: 1   B: 64  C: 0   D: 0   Payload: 
   CREATE VARIABLE timer_minimum_message_display::user::value
   // 
   CHECK VALUE Script Time::value > (timer_minimum_message_display::user::value)
      SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Waiting for Save Request::behavior
      SET VALUE MEM_saving_msg::sprite.field[0x07] to 0
      SET VALUE MEM_saving_icon::sprite.field[0x07] to 0
      SET VALUE prohibit_entering_levels::user::value to 0
      // 


[BEHAVIOR: Save Game: Card Changed, Select Save Game::behavior] A: 1   B: 88  C: 1   D: 0   Payload: 
   CHECK VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value == 1
      PRINT "In Error Master the player has chosen to continue without saving, so bail out." on self
      SET BEHAVIOR Restore before going back to Waiting for Save Request::behavior
      SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   // (Currently there is no HARDWARE TARGET difference in this Choice Screen.)
   CHECK VALUE self.field[0x01] == (self.field[0x01])
      // Set-up Selection System parameters
      CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 0
         // (Common set-up)
         CHECK VALUE self.field[0x01] == (self.field[0x01])
            INCREMENT VALUE state_display_message::user::value
            SET REFERENCE selection_return_behavior::user::behavior to behavior::user::behavior
            SET BEHAVIOR Selection Interface::behavior
            SET VALUE selection_state::user::value to 0
         // What is the message to be displayed?
         SET REFERENCE selection_message::user::sprite to MEM_error_card_changed::sprite
         // What are the selectable options?
         CHANGE MEMBERSHIP selection_options_sprites::set::sprite.include(MEM_sel_yes::sprite)
         CHANGE MEMBERSHIP selection_options_sprites::set::sprite.include(MEM_sel_no::sprite)
         // What is the default option?
         SET REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite to MEM_sel_no::sprite
         // Should there be a 'back' prompt?
         SET VALUE selection_back_prompt?::user::value to 0
         // Should there be a reaction if the card is removed?
         SET VALUE selection_react_to_card_removal?::user::value to 1
// 
// Selection System has returned
CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 1
   // Did the mem card get swapped?
   CHECK VALUE selection_card_removed?::user::value == 1
      SET REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite to MEM_sel_no::sprite
   // 
   CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_yes::sprite
      SET BEHAVIOR Title: Refresh (Verify) card before going to New/Load game menus::behavior
      SET VALUE new_or_load?::user::value to 0
      // 
      SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
      SET VALUE state_verify_card::user::value to 0
   // 
   CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_no::sprite
      SET BEHAVIOR New Game: Display 'Continue without saving' Message::behavior
      SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   // 


[BEHAVIOR: Restore before going back to Waiting for Save Request::behavior] A: 1   B: 56  C: 1   D: 0   Payload: 
   CHECK VALUE confirm_cancel_save::user::value != 0
      SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Display 'Cancel Save?' message::behavior
      SET VALUE confirm_cancel_save::user::value to 0
      SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
      // If not paused, pause
      CHECK VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value == 0
         CUT-SCENE COMMAND: 3 (pause!?)
         CONTROL Controller Monitor::actor, extra: 01
         CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 01
         CONTROL button_prompter::actor, extra: 01
         SET VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value to 1
PRINT "Clearing-up before returning to normal Waiting for Save Request behavior" on self
SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Waiting for Save Request::behavior
SET VALUE prohibit_entering_levels::user::value to 0
SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
// 
// If the player has chosen to turn autosave OFF, make sure any pending save activity is cleared.
CHECK VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value == 1
   SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 0
// UnPause, but only if there is no pending save activity
CHECK VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value == 0
   CUT-SCENE COMMAND: 2 (resume!?)
   SET VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value to 0
// 
// Restore the pre-error sprites.
CHECK VALUE error_restore_sprites::set::sprite > 0
   FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0
      CHECK VALUE ~each.field[0x07] == 1
         SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 0
   FOR EACH in error_restore_sprites::set::sprite, node point 0
      SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 1
   CHANGE MEMBERSHIP error_restore_sprites::set::sprite.remove(error_restore_sprites::set::sprite)
SET VALUE MEM_error_background::sprite.field[0x07] to 0
// 
// Restore the pre-error button prompt sprites.
CHANGE MEMBERSHIP button_prompts::set::sprite.add(restore_button_prompts_after_message::set::sprite)
FIND VARIABLE force_button_prompt_update?::user::value in button_prompter::actor
   SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
CHANGE MEMBERSHIP restore_button_prompts_after_message::set::sprite.remove(restore_button_prompts_after_message::set::sprite)


[BEHAVIOR: Title: Boot-Up Initialization::behavior] A: 1   B: 48  C: 0   D: 0   Payload: 
   CHECK VALUE Script Time::value < (timer_initialize::user::value)
      IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value != 1)
            SET BEHAVIOR Title: Boot-up Free Space check::behavior
            SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
         SET BEHAVIOR Title: Wait for Autosave Explanation to Complete::behavior


[BEHAVIOR: Title: Launch New/Load Menus::behavior] A: 1   B: 112 C: 0   D: 0   Payload: 
   SET BEHAVIOR Title: Set-Up Menu::behavior
   // Turn on the generic menu sprites.
   FOR EACH in Generic_List_Menu_Sprites::set::sprite, node point 0
      SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 1
   // -----------
   SET VALUE exit_pause?::user::value to 0
   SET VALUE menu_list_ID::user::value to 0
   SET VALUE new_menu_list_ID::user::value to 1
   // If we got here backing out of a deeper, paused Load or New game sub-menu, then unpause.
   CHECK VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value == 1
      CUT-SCENE COMMAND: 2 (resume!?)
      SET VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value to 0
   // Hide the button prompts
   CHANGE MEMBERSHIP button_prompts::set::sprite.remove(button_prompts::set::sprite)


[BEHAVIOR: Title: Boot-up Free Space check::behavior] A: 9   B: 128 C: 10  D: 0   Payload: 
   // This is the initial check for Memcard size, NOT used by XBox.
   CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 1
      SET BEHAVIOR Title: Wait for Autosave Explanation to Complete::behavior
   // Start
   CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 0
      INCREMENT VALUE state_display_message::user::value
      CHECK VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value == 0
         CUT-SCENE COMMAND: 3 (pause!?)
         CONTROL Controller Monitor::actor, extra: 01
         CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 01
         CONTROL button_prompter::actor, extra: 01
         SET VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value to 1
      // Preserve, then hide the visible sprites
      CHANGE MEMBERSHIP clean_up_sprites::set::sprite.remove(clean_up_sprites::set::sprite)
      FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0
         CHECK VALUE ~each.field[0x07] == 1
            CHANGE MEMBERSHIP clean_up_sprites::set::sprite.include(~each)
            SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 0
   // 
// Put up 'Checking' message
CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 1
   INCREMENT VALUE state_display_message::user::value
   // 
   SET VALUE MEM_error_background::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
   SET VALUE MEM_checking_msg::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
   SET VALUE timer_minimum_message_display::user::value to (Script Time::value + 1.0)
// 
// Trigger verify process
CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 2
   CHECK VALUE Script Time::value > (timer_minimum_message_display::user::value)
      SET VALUE MEM_checking_msg::sprite.field[0x07] to 0
      // We can get to this state as a 'retry' from the NO SPACE BOOT and NO CARD BOOT choice screens.
      CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x01] == 1
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 20
      INCREMENT VALUE state_display_message::user::value
      PRINT " <============= I am about to trigger a verify" on behavior::user::behavior
      SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] to 1
// 
// Monitor Verify Process
CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 3
   SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
   // Monitor the verifying status.  When <> 1,  check status to see result of verify.
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 1)
      // Verify is complete -- what was the result.
      IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 0)
            PRINT " <-------- Verify Succeeded!  There is a Mad game on the MemCard." on self
            SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 100
PRINT " <-------- Verify failed, but why?" on MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03]
CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] != 4
   PRINT "We got an error which was NOT INVALID PATH..." on self
   // 
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 0)
         // PS2 don't care -- move on.
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 100
      // We will only pay attention to other errors if we are on the GameCube
      CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 2
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 12
         SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 1
      // 
      CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 6
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 6
      // 
      CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 7
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 12
         SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 1
      // 
      CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 9
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 8
      // Well, if it ain't Access or Bad Device, ignore it and move on.
      SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 100
PRINT "The INVALID PATH error means that there is not yet a save game file on the memcard." on self
CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x02] >= (TCR_free_space_required::user::value)
   PRINT "There IS enough space on the card, so no warning is necessary." on self
   SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 100
PRINT "There is NOT enough space on the card, so we have to put up the NO_SPACE_BOOT message." on self
INCREMENT VALUE state_display_message::user::value
PRINT "" on state_display_message::user::value
SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] to 0
// 
// (NO SPACE BOOT choice screen.)
// Set-up Selection System parameters
CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 4
   CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 0
      // (Common set-up)
      CHECK VALUE self.field[0x01] == (self.field[0x01])
         INCREMENT VALUE state_display_message::user::value
         SET REFERENCE selection_return_behavior::user::behavior to behavior::user::behavior
         SET BEHAVIOR Selection Interface::behavior
         SET VALUE selection_state::user::value to 0
      // What is the message to be displayed?
      SET REFERENCE selection_message::user::sprite to MEM_error_no_space_boot::sprite
      // What are the selectable options?
      CHANGE MEMBERSHIP selection_options_sprites::set::sprite.include(MEM_sel_yes::sprite)
      CHANGE MEMBERSHIP selection_options_sprites::set::sprite.include(MEM_sel_no::sprite)
      // What is the default option?
      SET REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite to MEM_sel_no::sprite
      // Should there be a 'back' prompt?
      SET VALUE selection_back_prompt?::user::value to 0

   CHECK VALUE ~controlled_actor.field[0x01] == (~controlled_actor.field[0x01])
      CREATE VARIABLE coins_collected::user::value
      SET VALUE self.field[0x01] to (%_complete_value::user::value)
      // Okay, now derive the low 11 bits value (total coins collected)
      SET VALUE coins_collected::user::value to (MemCard::MemCard.field[0x0b] / 2048)
      SET VALUE coins_collected::user::value to (coins_collected::user::value * 2048)
      SET VALUE coins_collected::user::value to (MemCard::MemCard.field[0x0b] - coins_collected::user::value)
      // 
      // Now we've got just the total coins collected (there are 1100 total in the game).

   SET VALUE %_complete_value::user::value to (%_complete_value::user::value + total_money_collected::user::value)

         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0

      FOR EACH in clean_up_sprites::set::sprite, node point 0

      FOR EACH in spawned_sprites_to_be_removed::set::sprite, node point 0
         CHANGE MEMBERSHIP spawned_sprites_to_be_removed::set::sprite.remove(~each)

      SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0

[BEHAVIOR: Title: Refresh (Verify) card before going to New/Load game menus::behavior] A: 1   B: 240 C: 3   D: 0   Payload: 
   CREATE VARIABLE state_verify_card::user::value
   // Keep the error master disabled so that we can track errors ourself.
   CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 00
   // 
   // Set-up the verify process
   CHECK VALUE state_verify_card::user::value == 0
      PRINT "Putting up the 'Checking' screen." on self
      INCREMENT VALUE state_verify_card::user::value
      // 
      SET VALUE MEM_error_background::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
      // 
      SET VALUE MEM_checking_msg::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
      // 
      // Make sure this is cleared before we start the verify process.
      FIND VARIABLE NO_at_continue_without_saving?::user::value in Error_Master::actor
         CHECK VALUE ~found_variable == 0
      // 
      SET VALUE timer_minimum_message_display::user::value to (Script Time::value + 1.0)
   // 
   // Start the Verify Process
   CHECK VALUE state_verify_card::user::value == 1
      CHECK VALUE Script Time::value > (timer_minimum_message_display::user::value)
         PRINT "Setting-up the verify process..." on self
         INCREMENT VALUE state_verify_card::user::value
         // 
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
         PRINT " <============= I am about to trigger a verify" on self
         SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] to 1
   // 
   // Monitor the verify process
CHECK VALUE state_verify_card::user::value == 2
   SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
   // Monitor the verifying status.  When <> 1,  check status to see result of verify.
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 1)
      SET VALUE MEM_checking_msg::sprite.field[0x07] to 0
      // 
      // Pause the game
      CHECK VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value == 0
         CUT-SCENE COMMAND: 3 (pause!?)
         CONTROL Controller Monitor::actor, extra: 01
         CONTROL Error_Master::actor, extra: 01
         CONTROL button_prompter::actor, extra: 01
         SET VALUE in_cutscene_pause?::user::value to 1
      // 
      IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 0)
            PRINT " <-------- Verify Succeeded!" on self
            IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE new_or_load?::user::value == 0)
                  CHECK VALUE in_title_level?::user::value == 1
                     SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
                  CHECK VALUE card_changed?::user::value == 1
                     PRINT "<--------------- Card Changed while verifying." on temp::user::value
                     SET BEHAVIOR Save Game: Card Changed, Select Save Game::behavior
                  PRINT "<--------------- Go to New Game Menu" on temp::user::value
                  SET BEHAVIOR Title: Set-Up Menu::behavior
                  SET VALUE new_menu_list_ID::user::value to 2
                  // 
                  SET VALUE debounce_x_button::user::value to 1
                  // 
         CREATE VARIABLE any_slots_played?::user::value
// 
SET VALUE my_current_slot::user::value to (MemCard::MemCard.field[0x06])
SET VALUE any_slots_played?::user::value to 0
SET VALUE temp::user::value to 0
LOOP VALUE 4
   SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x06] to (temp::user::value)
   PRINT "" on MemCard::MemCard.field[0x07]
   CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x07] > 0
      SET VALUE any_slots_played?::user::value to 1
   INCREMENT VALUE temp::user::value
SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x06] to (my_current_slot::user::value)
PRINT " <==================== So, were any slots played?" on any_slots_played?::user::value
IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE any_slots_played?::user::value == 0)
      PRINT "<--------------- Go to <No Games to Load> choice screen." on temp::user::value
      SET BEHAVIOR Load Game: No Valid Games to Load::behavior
      SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   PRINT "<--------------- Go to Load Game Menu" on temp::user::value
   SET BEHAVIOR Title: Set-Up Menu::behavior
   SET VALUE new_menu_list_ID::user::value to 4
PRINT " <-------- Verify failed, but why?" on MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03]
IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 4)
      PRINT "The INVALID PATH error means that there is not yet a save game file on the memcard." on self
   // If we were going to the load menu, respond to a bad file error.
   CHECK VALUE new_or_load?::user::value == 1
      SET VALUE temp::user::value to 0
      // 
      CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 6
         SET VALUE temp::user::value to 1
         PRINT "An ACCESS error triggers going to the Boot Size Check behavior" on self
      // 
      CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 7
         SET VALUE temp::user::value to 1
         PRINT "A DATA MISMATCH error triggers going to the Boot Size Check behavior" on self
      // 
      // These checks for GameCube only
      CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 2
         CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 2
            SET VALUE temp::user::value to 1
            PRINT "An NO FORMAT error triggers going to the Boot Size Check behavior" on self
         // 
         CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 9
            SET VALUE temp::user::value to 1
            PRINT "An BAD DEVICE error triggers going to the Boot Size Check behavior" on self
      // 
      CHECK VALUE temp::user::value == 1
         SET BEHAVIOR Load Game: Memcard Error Check::behavior
         SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 0
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
// So, if we got here, we know the error was an Invalid Path, meaning there is no save game file on the memcard.
IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE new_or_load?::user::value == 0)
      SET BEHAVIOR New Game: Perform Free Space Check::behavior
      PRINT "<--------------- Since Verify Failed going to 'New Game', let's do a Free Space Check" on self
      SET VALUE IO_Operation_Type::user::value to 0
      SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] == 5)
         // There is no card!
         SET BEHAVIOR Load Game: No MemCard to load from::behavior
      // There is a card, but there is no Madagascar save data on the card
      SET BEHAVIOR Load Game: No Valid Games to Load::behavior
   SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0


[BEHAVIOR: New Game: Perform Free Space Check::behavior] A: 1   B: 240 C: 1   D: 0   Payload: 
   // Trigger Error Master to do a size check.
   CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 0
      INCREMENT VALUE state_display_message::user::value
      SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 2
      // Let everybody know we are trying to create a new save game file.
      PRINT "About to trigger a request for error master to do a size check" on behavior::user::behavior
      SET VALUE IO_Operation_Type::user::value to 5
   // 
   // Wait for Error Master to let us know if the size check succeeded.
   CHECK VALUE state_display_message::user::value == 1
      PRINT "Waiting for Error Master to let us know how the Size check went." on behavior::user::behavior
      CHECK VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value == 0
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
         // 
         PRINT "Space check is done..." on card_changed?::user::value
         FIND VARIABLE NO_at_continue_without_saving?::user::value in Error_Master::actor
            CHECK VALUE ~found_variable == 1
               PRINT "Upon return from the size check, notice that user chose NO at a 'Continue without Saving?' prompt in Error Master." on self
               SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
               IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE in_title_level?::user::value == 1)
                     SET BEHAVIOR Title: Launch New/Load Menus::behavior
                  SET BEHAVIOR Restore before going back to Waiting for Save Request::behavior
                  SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 1
                  SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
         // 
         // Did the user choose to Continue without saving?
         IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value == 1)
               PRINT "User chose to continue without saving." on behavior::user::behavior
               IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE in_title_level?::user::value == 1)
                     PRINT "Player chose to continue without saving.  We ARE in the title level, so go straight to the KingOfNY level." on behavior::user::behavior
                     SET BEHAVIOR Go to New Game in KingofNY::behavior
                  PRINT "Player chose to continue without saving.  We are not in the title level, so exit error display, turn autosave OFF." on behavior::user::behavior
                  SET BEHAVIOR Restore before going back to Waiting for Save Request::behavior
IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE in_title_level?::user::value == 0)
      // We are NOT in the title level
      IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE card_changed?::user::value == 1)
            PRINT "The card was changed during the size check, now we don't know if there is already a MAD save file on it, so start over." on self
            SET BEHAVIOR Restore before going back to Waiting for Save Request::behavior
            SET VALUE MEMCARD Auto Save Kickoff::user::value to 1
         CHECK VALUE IO_Operation_Type::user::value == 5
            PRINT "NEW GAME: Size check successful!" on self
            SET BEHAVIOR New Game: Display "Create New Game File?' message::behavior
            SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   // We ARE in the title level
   CHECK VALUE card_changed?::user::value == 1
      // The card was swapped, we don't really know the status of the card, so go verify it again.
      SET VALUE IO_Operation_Type::user::value to 0
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE IO_Operation_Type::user::value == 5)
         PRINT "NEW GAME: Size check successful!" on self
         SET BEHAVIOR New Game: Display "Create New Game File?' message::behavior
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
      PRINT "Card changed, re-verifying card." on behavior::user::behavior
      SET BEHAVIOR Title: Refresh (Verify) card before going to New/Load game menus::behavior
      SET VALUE new_or_load?::user::value to 0
      SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
      SET VALUE state_verify_card::user::value to 0

   // DG - If *Level_Music has NOT been set to anything, this is going to return false. Hooray!
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE Level_Music::user::sound.field[0x01] >= 0)
      PRINT "No level music has been set yet!" on self
   // Check to see if the "music full volume in cutscene" overide is active
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE music volume override::user::value == 1)
         // Full volume for new music activated during a cutscene
         SLIDE VALUE current music::user::sound.field[0x01] to 100 over 0.20000000298023224 seconds, ease_out: Level_Music::user::sound, ease_in: Level_Music::user::sound
         // When Cutscene ends turn off the override
         CHECK VALUE Cut-scene Active::value == 0
            SET VALUE music volume override::user::value to 0
      // Not in "override" mode, below we control the volume during cutscenes and normal play
      // TS-I put 'slide value' commands in here to help to create more gradual volume transitions
      IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE Cut-scene Active::value == 1)
            SLIDE VALUE current music::user::sound.field[0x01] to 30 over 0.20000000298023224 seconds, ease_out: Level_Music::user::sound, ease_in: Level_Music::user::sound
         SLIDE VALUE current music::user::sound.field[0x01] to 100 over 0.20000000298023224 seconds, ease_out: Level_Music::user::sound, ease_in: Level_Music::user::sound
      CHECK MESSAGE Time_ran_out::message from players::set::actor, extra 2 with value 0
         SET BEHAVIOR don't play music::behavior
         STOP SOUND current music::user::sound
// Has there been a change in music?
IF/ELSE (CHECK REFERENCE current music::user::sound is reference to Level_Music::user::sound)
      // No change
      CHECK VALUE current music::user::sound.field[0x04] == 0
         CHECK VALUE Cut-scene Active::value == 0
            // DG - If someone tries to set a music reference in a cutscene, it may not get played if the player skips
            PLAY SOUND current music::user::sound
   PRINT "HEY! Music changed!" on Level_Music::user::sound
   IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE Cut-scene Active::value == 1)
         // DG - If we change music in a cutscene, we really don't wanna wait around
         PRINT "Music swapped in a CUTSCENE!" on self
         STOP SOUND current music::user::sound
         SET REFERENCE current music::user::sound to Level_Music::user::sound
         SET VALUE music volume override::user::value to 1
         PLAY SOUND current music::user::sound
      // Lower the music volume then get ready to swap songs
      SLIDE VALUE current music::user::sound.field[0x01] to 0 over 0.5 seconds, ease_out: Level_Music::user::sound, ease_in: Level_Music::user::sound

                  // So, do we do have an error? (1 = busy, so it isn't really an error)
                  CHECK VALUE my_error::user::value > 1
                     // Is this the same error as last frame?
                     IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE my_error::user::value == (previous_memcard_error::user::value))
                           // If the error is unchanged, we can 'run' the selection system, similar to the one
                           // found in the SaveGame Master.
                           // This code drives selection.  Both set-up and clean-up are handled in other
                           // parts of this script.
                        // 
                        // Managing Selection
                        // 
                        PRINT "======  In Selection System ======" on self
                        CHECK VALUE self.field[0x01] == (self.field[0x01])
                           CHECK VALUE selection_options_sprites::set::sprite > 1
                              IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE debounce_dpad_up::user::value == 0)
                                    IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x0d] == 1)
                                          SET VALUE debounce_dpad_up::user::value to 1
                                          SET VALUE selection_selected_option_changed?::user::value to 1
                                          IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE selection_option_index::user::value == 1)
                                                SET VALUE selection_option_index::user::value to (selection_options_sprites::set::sprite)
                                             DECREMENT VALUE selection_option_index::user::value
                                          PLAY SOUND UI_Select::sound
                                       CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x11] >= (ANALOG_THRESHOLD::user::value)
                                          SET VALUE debounce_dpad_up::user::value to 1
                                          SET VALUE selection_selected_option_changed?::user::value to 1
                                          IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE selection_option_index::user::value == 1)
                                                SET VALUE selection_option_index::user::value to (selection_options_sprites::set::sprite)
                                             DECREMENT VALUE selection_option_index::user::value
                                          PLAY SOUND UI_Select::sound
                                 CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x0d] == 0
                                    CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x11] < (ANALOG_THRESHOLD::user::value)
                                       SET VALUE debounce_dpad_up::user::value to 0
                           IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE debounce_dpad_down::user::value == 0)
                                 IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x0e] == 1)
                                       SET VALUE debounce_dpad_down::user::value to 1
                                       SET VALUE selection_selected_option_changed?::user::value to 1
                                       IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE selection_option_index::user::value == (selection_options_sprites::set::sprite))
                                             SET VALUE selection_option_index::user::value to 1
                                          INCREMENT VALUE selection_option_index::user::value
                                       PLAY SOUND UI_Select::sound
                                    CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x12] >= (ANALOG_THRESHOLD::user::value)
                                       SET VALUE debounce_dpad_down::user::value to 1
                                       SET VALUE selection_selected_option_changed?::user::value to 1
                                       IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE selection_option_index::user::value == (selection_options_sprites::set::sprite))
                                             SET VALUE selection_option_index::user::value to 1
                                          INCREMENT VALUE selection_option_index::user::value
                                       PLAY SOUND UI_Select::sound
                              CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x0e] == 0
                                 CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x12] < (ANALOG_THRESHOLD::user::value)
                                    SET VALUE debounce_dpad_down::user::value to 0
                           CHECK VALUE selection_selected_option_changed?::user::value == 1
                              SET VALUE selection_selected_option_changed?::user::value to 0
                              SET VALUE MEM_sel_frame_0::sprite.field[0x05] to Color(75, 128, 0, 192)
                              SET VALUE MEM_sel_frame_1::sprite.field[0x05] to Color(75, 128, 0, 192)
                              SET VALUE MEM_sel_frame_2::sprite.field[0x05] to Color(75, 128, 0, 192)
                              SET VALUE MEM_sel_frame_0::sprite.field[0x03] to Pair16: (-1000, 80)
                              SET VALUE MEM_sel_frame_1::sprite.field[0x03] to Pair16: (1000, 80)
                              SET VALUE MEM_sel_frame_2::sprite.field[0x03] to Pair16: (-1000, 80)
                              // 
                              IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE selection_option_index::user::value == 1)
                                    SET REFERENCE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite to MEM_sel_frame_0::sprite
                                    SLIDE VALUE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite.field[0x03] to Pair16: (-1100, 90) over 0.10000000149011612 seconds, ease_out: Play Mode::value, ease_in: Play Mode::value
                                 IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE selection_option_index::user::value == 2)
                                       SET REFERENCE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite to MEM_sel_frame_1::sprite
                                       SLIDE VALUE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite.field[0x03] to Pair16: (1100, 90) over 0.10000000149011612 seconds, ease_out: Play Mode::value, ease_in: Play Mode::value
                                    CHECK VALUE selection_option_index::user::value == 3
                                       SET REFERENCE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite to MEM_sel_frame_2::sprite
                                       SLIDE VALUE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite.field[0x03] to Pair16: (-1100, 90) over 0.10000000149011612 seconds, ease_out: Play Mode::value, ease_in: Play Mode::value
                              SET VALUE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite.field[0x05] to Color(115, 192, 0, 192)
                        IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE selection_alpha_cycle::user::value == 0)
                              SLIDE VALUE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite.field[0x05].sub[0x04] to 254 over 0.25 seconds, ease_out: Play Mode::value, ease_in: Play Mode::value
                                 SET VALUE selection_alpha_cycle::user::value to 1
                           SLIDE VALUE selection_selected_frame::user::sprite.field[0x05].sub[0x04] to 192 over 0.25 seconds, ease_out: Play Mode::value, ease_in: Play Mode::value
                              SET VALUE selection_alpha_cycle::user::value to 0
                     // 
                     // Player chose option?
                     IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE debounce_x_button::user::value == 0)
                           CHECK VALUE controller 1::controller.field[0x03] == 1
                              SET VALUE debounce_x_button::user::value to 1
                              PLAY SOUND UI_Accept::sound
                              SET VALUE temp::user::value to 1
                              FOR EACH in selection_options_sprites::set::sprite, node point 0
                                 CHECK VALUE temp::user::value == (selection_option_index::user::value)
                                    SET REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite to ~each
                                 INCREMENT VALUE temp::user::value
                              // 
                              // 2 : Unformatted card?
                              CHECK VALUE MEM_error_format::sprite.field[0x07] == 1
                                 CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 0
                                    // Yes: Format the card.
                                    CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_yes::sprite
                                       SET BEHAVIOR Format card::behavior
                                       SET VALUE go_to_cancel?::user::value to 0
                                       SET VALUE state_card_operation::user::value to 0
                                       CHANGE MEMBERSHIP button_prompts::set::sprite.remove(button_prompts::set::sprite)
                                    // Yes: Format the card.
                                    CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_no::sprite
                                       SET BEHAVIOR Format card::behavior
                                       SET VALUE go_to_cancel?::user::value to 1
                                       SET VALUE state_card_operation::user::value to 0
                                       CHANGE MEMBERSHIP button_prompts::set::sprite.remove(button_prompts::set::sprite)
                              // (Not an Xbox option)
                           CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 2
                              // Continue without saving
                              CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_cont_w_out::sprite
                                 SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
                                 SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
                                 SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 1
                                 SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
                                 SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
                                 FIND VARIABLE confirm_cancel_save::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
                                    SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
                              // Retry
                              CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_retry::sprite
                                 SET BEHAVIOR Retry::behavior
                                 SET VALUE state_retry::user::value to 0
                              // Format
                              CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_format_mem::sprite
                                 SET BEHAVIOR Format card::behavior
                                 SET VALUE state_card_operation::user::value to 0
                                 CHANGE MEMBERSHIP button_prompts::set::sprite.remove(button_prompts::set::sprite)
                        // 3 : Insufficient Space?
                  CHECK VALUE MEM_error_no_space::sprite.field[0x07] == 1
                     CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 0
                        // Yes: continue without saving
                        CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_yes::sprite
                           SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
                           SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
                           SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 1
                           SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
                           SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
                           FIND VARIABLE confirm_cancel_save::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
                              SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
                           FIND VARIABLE debounce_x_button::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
                              SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
                        // 
                        // No? Go back to Main Menu/Retry
                        CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_no::sprite
                           IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE in_title_level?::user::value == 1)
                                 SET BEHAVIOR Cleanup After Error Resolved::behavior
                                 SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
                                 SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
                                 SET VALUE NO_at_continue_without_saving?::user::value to 1
                                 SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
                              SET BEHAVIOR Retry::behavior
                              SET VALUE state_retry::user::value to 0
                     CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 1
                        // Continue without saving
                        CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_cont_w_out::sprite
                           SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
                           SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
                           SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 1
                           SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
                           SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
                           FIND VARIABLE confirm_cancel_save::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
                              SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
                           FIND VARIABLE debounce_x_button::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
                              SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
                        // Go to the Dashboard
                        CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_manage_mem::sprite
                           SET BEHAVIOR Confirm Exit to Memory Card Manager::behavior
                           FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0
                              CHECK VALUE ~each.field[0x07] == 1
                                 SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 0
                           SET VALUE MEM_error_background::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
                           SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
            CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 2
               // Continue without saving
               CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_cont_w_out::sprite
                  SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
                  SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
                  SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 1
                  SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
                  SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
                  FIND VARIABLE confirm_cancel_save::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
                     SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
                  FIND VARIABLE debounce_x_button::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
                     SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
               // Retry
               CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_retry::sprite
                  SET BEHAVIOR Retry::behavior
                  SET VALUE state_retry::user::value to 0
         // (Xbox, NGC only)
         CHECK VALUE MEM_error_no_space_boot::sprite.field[0x07] == 1
            // This msg is shown by Error Master only on NGC and Xbox AND only in the title level.
   CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 1
      // Continue without saving
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_cont_w_out::sprite
         SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
         SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
         SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 1
         SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
         SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
      // Go to the Dashboard
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_manage_mem::sprite
         SET BEHAVIOR Confirm Exit to Memory Card Manager::behavior
         FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0
            CHECK VALUE ~each.field[0x07] == 1
               SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 0
         SET VALUE MEM_error_background::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 2
   // Continue without saving
   CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_cont_w_out::sprite
      SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
      SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
      SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 1
      SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
      SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
   // Retry
   CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_retry::sprite
      SET BEHAVIOR Retry::behavior
      SET VALUE state_retry::user::value to 0
   // Go to Memory Card Manager
   CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_manage_mem::sprite
      // Use cryptic method to launch memory card manager
      SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x03] to 8
// 4 : Invalid Path?
CHECK VALUE MEM_error_invalid::sprite.field[0x07] == 1
   CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 0
      // Okay, go to <Continue Without Saving> choice screen.
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_okay::sprite
         SET BEHAVIOR Continue without Saving?::behavior
         FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0
            CHECK VALUE ~each.field[0x07] == 1
               SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 0
         SET VALUE MEM_error_background::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 1
      // Okay, go to <Continue Without Saving> choice screen.
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_okay::sprite
         SET BEHAVIOR Continue without Saving?::behavior
         FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0
            CHECK VALUE ~each.field[0x07] == 1
               SET VALUE ~each.field[0x07] to 0
         SET VALUE MEM_error_background::sprite.field[0x07] to 1
         SET VALUE state_display_message::user::value to 0
   CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 2
      // Okay, go to <Continue Without Saving> choice screen.
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_okay::sprite
         SET BEHAVIOR Continue without Saving?::behavior
         FOR EACH in active::set::sprite, node point 0

// 5 : No Card?
CHECK VALUE MEM_error_no_card::sprite.field[0x07] == 1
   CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 0
      // Yes: Start game anyway. Continue without saving.
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_yes::sprite
         SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
         SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 1
         SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
         SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
         SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
         PRINT " ============== Player chose to continue without saving" on self
         FIND VARIABLE confirm_cancel_save::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
            SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
         FIND VARIABLE debounce_x_button::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
            SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
      // No? Clear error and set 'No at...' flag.
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_no::sprite
         IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE in_title_level?::user::value == 1)
               SET BEHAVIOR Cleanup After Error Resolved::behavior
               SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
               SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
               SET VALUE NO_at_continue_without_saving?::user::value to 1
               SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
            SET BEHAVIOR Retry::behavior
            SET VALUE state_retry::user::value to 0
   CHECK VALUE Hardware Target::value == 1
      // Yes: Start game anyway. Continue without saving.
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_yes::sprite
         SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
         SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
         SET VALUE prompted_to_insert_memcard?::user::value to 1
         SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
         SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
         FIND VARIABLE confirm_cancel_save::user::value in SaveGame_Master::actor
            SET VALUE ~found_variable to 1
      // No? Clear error and set 'No at...' flag.
      CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_no::sprite
         IF/ELSE (CHECK VALUE in_title_level?::user::value == 1)
               SET BEHAVIOR Cleanup After Error Resolved::behavior
               SET VALUE ~found_variable to 0
               SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0
               SET VALUE NO_at_continue_without_saving?::user::value to 1
               SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
            SET BEHAVIOR Retry::behavior
            SET VALUE state_retry::user::value to 0

   // Yes: Start game anyway. Continue without saving.
   CHECK REFERENCE selection_selected_option::user::sprite is reference to MEM_sel_opt_cont_w_out::sprite
      SET VALUE IO_Error::user::value to 0

      SET VALUE MemCard::MemCard.field[0x05] to 0
      SET VALUE card_changed?::user::value to 0
